description_en: Queries the active duration of a mobile phone number on the carrier network
description_zh: 查询手机用户在运营商侧的在网时长
name: DescribePhoneNumberOnlineTime

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.
On the My Applications page of the Phone Number Encyclopedia console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。
在号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)我的申请页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to be queried.

If Mask is set to NORMAL, this parameter is an 11-digit mobile phone number.
If Mask is set to MD5, this parameter is a 32-character encrypted string.
If Mask is set to SHA256, this parameter is a 64-character encrypted string.

<notice>Letters in the encrypted string are not case-sensitive.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为11位手机号码。
若Mask取值为MD5，该字段为32位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SHA256，该字段为64位加密字符串。

<notice>加密字符串中字母不区分大小写。></notice>
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method for the phone number. Valid values:

NORMAL: No encryption.
MD5
SHA256
parameters.help_zh:
号码的加密方式。取值：

NORMAL：不加密
MD5
SHA256
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en:
The carrier. Valid values:

MOBILE: China Mobile.
UNICOM: China Unicom.
TELECOM: China Telecom.

<notice>This parameter is optional. Alibaba Cloud automatically determines the carrier based on the phone number. The value of this parameter does not affect the query result.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
对外运营商。取值：

MOBILE：中国移动。
UNICOM：中国联通。
TELECOM：中国电信。

<notice>非必填项，阿里云会根据号码归属的运营商类型做自动判断，该字段的取值对查询结果无任何影响。></notice>
parameters.name: carrier

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request. Valid values:

OK: The request is successful.
PortabilityNumberNotSupported: The mobile number portability (MNP) number is not supported.
RequestFrequencyLimit: Due to carrier restrictions, frequent queries for the same number within a short period are prohibited. If this error code is returned, try again later.

You are billed when Code is set to OK and VerifyResult is not -1. For more information about billing, see [Phone Number Encyclopedia pricing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154751.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：请求成功。
PortabilityNumberNotSupported：不支持的携号转网号码。
RequestFrequencyLimit：因运营商限制，禁止在短时间内高频对同一个号码进行反复查询，如返回此错误码，请您稍后再试。

当Code取值为OK，且VerifyResult值不为-1时计费，计费文档请参见[号码百科定价]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154751.html）

CarrierCode.description_en:
The SMS status code of the carrier. Valid values:
CMCC: China Mobile.
CUCC: China Unicom.
CTCC: China Telecom.
CBN: China Broadnet
CarrierCode.description_zh:
运营商短信状态码。取值：
CMCC：中国移动
CUCC：中国联通
CTCC：中国电信
CBN：中国广电

VerifyResult.description_en:
The enumerated value of the active duration on the carrier network. Valid values:

-1: No duration found.
0: The mobile phone status is abnormal, such as a vacant number.
1: [0, 3) months.
2: [3, 6) months.
3: [6, 12) months.
4: [12, 24) months.
5: [24, +∞) months

Message.description_en: The description of the phone number status code
